name: How long does drywall mudding and taping usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does drywall mudding and taping usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most drywall finishing takes at least 2 to 3 coats: one to bed the tape, one to build the joint, and one to refine the surface. A simple room can often be finished in a few days, but drying time, room temperature, and humidity can stretch the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan on 2–3 coats and multiple drying periods, so even a straightforward job usually takes several days from start to ready-to-paint.
